endorsements.quote: A common insight was to engage a broad range of interest holders from community members to administrators in the process and discussion, from initiation to execution and maintenance.
The participants also noted the need for processes to confirm that AI/ML tools are operating as intended through ongoing quality assurance and quality control checks.

unlisted_practices: Conduct AI/ML development and use under the principles of Indigenous data sovereignty, with Tribal governance of data.
Include consent, standardisation and governance in AI/ML policy-making and best practices.
Use system metrics to verify AI/ML performance and behaviour.
Distinguish quality improvement from research when implementing AI/ML and apply the appropriate review pathway to each.
Validate AI/ML algorithms using AN/AI EHR data to address under-representation of AN/AI patients in AI/ML datasets.

screen.reason: Symposium report outlining perspectives, governance principles, and recommendations for AI/ML deployment, data sovereignty, and policy in Alaska Native healthcare systems.
